snippet.title: Compress(space) - Official Demo Gameplay Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Get a look at the Demo Gameplay Trailer for Compress(space), a space-altering puzzle game developed by B-Deshi Interactive. Players will set out to harness the power of space manipulation to overcome challenges using unorthodox methods to solve puzzles. Reach beyond the stars in Compress(space), coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo available now on PC.
